evals.prompt: Look at how 5 note-taking meeting assistants handle search across past meetings and tell me what we should copy for our history page.
evals.expected_output: A study folder with a brief, raw captures of help-center pages (with UI screenshots) for at least 5 products, concept cards for the search patterns, and a report with a feature matrix whose first column is our product and must/should/nice recommendations.
assertions: kb/research/<date>_<slug>/brief.md exists and lists the products and dimensions
At least 5 products appear in the report's feature matrix, the first column is the user's product
Most raw pages are help-center/docs articles, not product home pages
At least 8 screenshots of real product UI are linked from raw/wiki
Every checked ✅ cell has a raw page containing the key term (grep_claim.py finds it)

evals.prompt: which speech-to-text APIs support speaker identification with voice enrollment, and what do they charge? need a quick tech comparison for choosing a vendor
evals.expected_output: A technology-focused study: technology table (engine, deployment, API, pricing) and feature matrix for enrollment/identification, no UX section, numbers only from captured pricing/docs pages, limitations listing what could not be verified.
assertions: The report has a technology/pricing table with a source link per row
Every price or limit in the report is found in a raw page by grep_claim.py
No UX/UI section is forced into the report; the brief's dimensions exclude UX
check_research.py is run with --min-screenshots 0 and prints OK

evals.prompt: Split a competitor map for our product into 4 areas and run them with 4 agents in parallel, then give me one consolidated market map.
evals.expected_output: Four studies with identical report skeletons dispatched with absolute skill paths, parallel-mode rules in each brief, review by grep spot-checks, then a consolidation report with one merged matrix and entity cards created from the draft product cards.
assertions: Each dispatch message contains an absolute path to .agents/skills/market-research/SKILL.md
Every brief contains the parallel-mode rules (no edits to kb/wiki/entities or index.md)
No area PR modifies kb/wiki/entities/ or kb/wiki/index.md
A consolidation report kb/wiki/reports/<date>_market-map.md links all area reports
kb/wiki/entities/ cards are created from the draft product cards with raw links
